_comment: Devices whose runs count toward the official cross-device score.
Every device that submits a bundle still appears on the plot and in the
per-device table; only the ones listed here enter the combined figure.
This is deliberately a manual allowlist: a run from a thermally throttled
laptop on battery is real data about that laptop and useless as a grade.
Device ids come from the bundle's device.id, printed when a run finishes.
